content.w73745961: Suitable. The dark green bottle has no label and sits in the background of a museum kitchen display; nothing shows it is alcohol. Its shape is a typical wine/champagne bottle, though, so for a conservative family audience the editor may still remove it (it could even become one of the differences). It is not a blocker.
content.w69344105: Suitable. The real business name 'Willie's' appears on the chalk 'WILLIES Entrance' sign in the door glass and on the menu board ('WILLIE'S BREAKFAST / WILLIE'S LUNCH'). Picture A also shows the hanging sign 'Willie's since 1887, 537 Johnson St.' (removed in B as #4). It is an incidental shop name in a street photo, not advertising and nothing unsuitable. The game does not add it, so it is fine. Only a strict no-real-business-names policy would need another picture, because the text cannot be edited.
